summary.text: Primordial Ash Owl Transformation is a transformation path killer move that lets a Gu Immortal become the immemorial desolate beast Primordial Ash Owl for a large strength boost.

claims.text: Inside Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, Fang Yuan enters an ordinary true inheritance left by Giant Sun Immortal Venerable. The inheritance holds an item of Reckless Savage Demon Venerable and shows Reckless Savage facing the immemorial desolate beast Primordial Ash Owl.

Immemorial desolate beasts have rank eight Gu Immortal battle strength. Primordial Ash Owl has a bird head and beast body, two pairs of golden pupils, a dragon horn, and thick rainbow feathers. It can destroy mountains and rivers, send a growl ten thousand li, and shoot blue thunderbolt from its mouth. Reckless Savage Demon Venerable withstands that lightning, crushes the beast with one punch, then expands into a giant, eats it, and gains a new belly totem in its form. A trace of Reckless Savage’s will in the inheritance strikes Fang Yuan; Mo Yao’s will says Giant Sun Immortal Venerable modified the test so mortals can endure it, and that with a ten-edge owner token Fang Yuan already has authority to inherit this ordinary true inheritance.

After the vision ends, Fang Yuan reads the inheritance as Primordial Ash Owl Transformation, a transformation path killer move. It lets a Gu Immortal transform into Primordial Ash Owl and gain a huge boost in strength. Reckless Savage Demon Venerable is named as the progenitor of strength path and the creator of transformation path, with endless beast transformations among his methods. Fang Yuan lets the red light lump fly away: the true inheritance is precious, but it does not suit him then.
